title: REWIND artists' interviews
description: Facts about British and international video artists, their works, exhibitions and collaborators, extracted from [REWIND](https://rewind.ac.uk/) interviews and queried with [BeingDB](https://github.com/jptmoore/beingdb) in your browser. The facts were extracted by a language model: they are a **research artifact**, not verified catalogue metadata. Browse **Predicates** for the vocabulary, or learn the query language in the [tutorial](https://jptmoore.github.io/beingdb-wasm/tutorial/).

examples.title: Works made 1975-1980
examples.query:
find Artist, Work, Y
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  year_created(Work, Y)
  Y between 1975 and 1980
order by Y ascending

examples.title: Most prolific artists
examples.query:
find Artist, count(Work)
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
order by count(Work) descending
limit 5

examples.title: Kevin Atherton's media
examples.query:
find Work, Medium
where
  created_by(Work, kevin_atherton)
  uses_medium(Work, Medium)

examples.title: Collaborations
examples.query:
find Artist, Collaborator
where
  collaborated_with(Artist, Collaborator)
limit 20

examples.title: Exhibitions about video
examples.query:
find Exhibition, Title
where
  exhibition_title(Exhibition, Title)
  Title contains "video"
